title: Build-6 source-derived twelve-public-image qualitative check
scope: One fixed serial iOS27.1 Simulator experiment using unchanged build-6 processing. Source-derived engine integration, not actual production app UI or broad recognition acceptance.

qaChangedOriginals: Package.swift: isolated bundle and neutral resources

protocol.model: SystemLanguageModel.default, default Apple guardrails, fixed prompt/schema/options/policy and production deadlines unchanged.
protocol.metadataBoundary: Neutral IDs route report rows only. No captions, expected answers, provenance, mapping, filenames or label OCR text enter the image prompt. Original Practice assets remain compiled but are not selected. Visible incidental bottle text remains untrusted pixels.
protocol.stopPolicy: Any model unavailable/error/timeout/notRun/cancellation or strict amount/source/separation/preparation/persistence breach stops the batch without retry; remaining cases stay unrun. No stop occurred.
protocol.timerScope: 45/600-second in-app timers require MainActor scheduling. Host observation deadline660 has separate bounded wrapper cleanup, not an OS compute-stop or timing guarantee. Failure/cleanup branches were statically reviewed, not exercised by this successful run.
protocol.attemptScope: One recorded host install/launch, entry-intent checkpoints and twelve inspected-return reports; not a machine-wide audit or view into framework internal generation/retries.

inputReview.basis: Two independent pixel-only AI-agent reviews before inference; root reconciled three selected pixels with prior metadata exposure. AI annotations are not qualified human, clinical, nutrition or edibility ground truth.

dedup.limitation: Finite retained fixture corpus and known source metadata only. Prior experiments screened additional UEC/Food101/pet/flower/CIFAR samples beyond these retained copies. No whole-machine, complete-prior-screening or model-training independence claim. Perceptual hashes can miss transformed/cropped duplicates; root visual distinctness review remains separate.

Geometry-only declared standard-width fallback selected500×673 before review/inference. Preserved records are in collection-v1/initial-provider-bound-failure and provider-bound-rejections.json.
transportHistory.rateLimit: Commons429 after C01–C10; preserved partial state and accepted hashes. After cooldown only C11/C12 were requested; prior ten inputs were not refetched or replaced. No model-driven selection occurred.

inputReview.privacyLimits: Two AI reviews saw no identifiable face or private identifier; P09 possible indistinct hand and P11 ambiguous spoon reflection remain documented. This is not a qualified privacy release or a proven people-free set. Source rights/provenance do not establish visual contents.
inputReview.futureUse: All twelve images and these outputs are now exposed development evidence; do not reuse them as a fresh held-out acceptance set.

cases.assessment: This is a semantic food-channel error, even though the noun identifies the visible object reasonably. The final record does not expose the raw visibleFood decision or policy reason; do not infer those internal values.

findings.issue: Nonfood-object text survived into the final food-clue channel. A bounded text name and correct object noun are insufficient to establish an edible-food clue. Any future correction needs a separately frozen evaluation; this observation alone does not validate a blacklist or a new semantic gate.

Poor-fit or recipe-specific names can sound more established than the visible evidence supports. Pâté is a weak principal clue for the exposed green-interior browned pieces; lasagna is plausible but concealed-recipe specificity.

An ambiguous food-like object received a geometric descriptor rather than useful food guidance or abstention. Preserve the uncertain stratum; do not turn its caption or the returned descriptor into material/edibility truth.
Broad served-side recognition remains mixed with unconfirmed recipe, vegetable-type and preparation labels. P08 output cannot be localized to base versus side bowl; P09 green beans is unconfirmed.
Visible mixed-dish elements are still listed separately. This is a main-dish granularity concern, not proof that the named visible elements were hallucinated.

interpretation: Mechanical completion did not establish semantic accuracy. Nonfood object and generic-shape text survived the food-clue channel, some dish/type/method names are unconfirmed or poor fits, and visible mixed-dish decomposition persists. Empty lists on sponge and yarn are two observed abstentions, not general nonfood reliability.
nextStep: Review a general food-kind/abstention approach that preserves culturally varied food names and correction. Do not patch only these object words or optimize to these exposed photos; freeze a future proposal and new evaluation before making an improvement claim. Full exact-app photo/label/checked-amount/history, accessibility, later physical offline and applicant/2027 gates remain open.
limits: accuracy percentage or exhaustive per-food score
causal or persistent improvement over another prompt/model/app
qualified clinical or nutrition ground truth
serving mass, carbohydrate or insulin inference
full production app journey or runtime acceptance beyond the recorded source-derived processing
privacyAndDistribution: Only curated source/evidence metadata is published. Research images, QA helper/controller, logs, binaries, archives, device/container/account paths stay outside the repository and Challenge ZIP. No app distribution change or new upload; build6 testing-only/manual-release/server-processing limits remain.
